name: Last Call
source:
You've made the tough choice to go help out an uncle whose health is failing. Sure, it's a lot of work running his bar in his tiny Midwestern town, but it's a charming place and it's growing on you. Yeah, it meant dropping out mid-semester and leaving your girlfriend Fiona behind, but family is worth it... right? 

In Last Call you play as the over-worked and somewhat awkward hero as he deals with a failing long-distance relationship, a feisty cougar, a charming rebel, the local drunks, and the joy of running the favorite watering hole in Oaklane.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/thunderlinestudios]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你做出了艰难的决定，去帮助一位健康状况日渐恶化的叔舅辈亲人。的确，在美国中西部的小镇上替他经营酒吧很辛苦，但这里别有魅力，也越来越让你喜欢。没错，这意味着你得在学期中途退学，离开女友菲奥娜，可为了家人，这一切值得……对吧？

在《Last Call》中，你将扮演这位工作繁重、又有些笨拙的主角，应付一段岌岌可危的异地恋、一位泼辣又偏爱年轻男人的熟女、一位迷人的叛逆者，还有当地的酒鬼，同时体验经营橡树巷镇最受欢迎酒吧的乐趣。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/thunderlinestudios]Patreon[/url]]
